## reset

Reset Email Settings. `DELETE /email-settings`

Reset email settings to defaults (clears all custom settings).

Database: PRIMARY (tenants table)

```php

```

- Scopes: `settings:admin`

Returns `EmailSettingsReset`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Email%20Settings/reset_email_settings_api_v1_email_settings_delete)
